name: Mitsubishi Electric Power Device Works Fukuyama Factory
summary: A silicon power semiconductor wafer processing plant of Mitsubishi Electric's Power Device Works in Fukuyama, Hiroshima Prefecture, set up in a three-storey building of about 46,500 m2 that the company bought from Sharp Fukuyama Semiconductor in 2020. It started operations in November 2021 and began mass production on 200 mm wafers in April 2022. A 300 mm line was installed by August 2023 and in September 2024 the factory began large-scale supply of chips made on 300 mm wafers for module assembly. It is central to the company's plan to double silicon power wafer capacity by fiscal 2026 from five years earlier.
